jobs.description: Working at Vikoplant Welcome to Vikoplant BV, where green is our passion! We are a dynamic export company dedicated to the world of indoor and outdoor plants in all their glory. Our team members share a passion for green, and we strongly believe in the power of personal connections. With us, it's all about relationships because we know that this is the key to providing perfect service to our valued customers. We have established a strong position in the market and collaborate with supermarket chains, wholesale companies, and garden centers in more than ten European countries. Located in the vibrant business area of Trade Parc Westland, we find ourselves in the heart of the largest cultivation region in the Netherlands. And here's your opportunity to join our team! We are looking for an enthusiastic: Order Picker What does your average day look like? • Receiving goods • Scanning the received batches • Preparing carts for shipment to our customers • Important administrative tasks • Other warehouse duties as required Who are you? • Minimum MBO level • No 9-to-5 mentality • Attention to detail • Administrative skills • Proficiency in Dutch, with knowledge of English and German as a bonus. Are you as enthusiastic as we are to surprise our customers every day? Don't hesitate and send your CV and a motivation letter to info@vikoplant.nl , attention to Paul van Leeuwen.

As an experienced warehouse employee, you manage the flow of goods to keep shipments moving without delays. Your workday starts at 08:00 with checking the priority lists and preparing your electric pallet truck (EPT). Throughout the day, you collect orders, build stable pallets, cross-reference order data in Excel, and run thorough quality inspections. By 17:00, all pallets are securely wrapped, verified, and staged at the outbound docks. As a Logistics Employee Inbound, you are responsible for receiving goods and checking all incoming products. You make sure all goods are received, checked, and processed correctly so that the logistics process runs smoothly.Every day you'll unload deliveries, check products for quantity, quality, and any damages.
